notes:
Summary:
- Vertical: fintech payments fraud + conversational support (risk explanations).
- Primary pain: production inference cost + unpredictable tail latency during peak events (batching spikes).
- Target SLOs: chat p95 <50ms for token generation for 256-context; reranker p99 <120ms; sustained throughput target 150-300 req/s across 3 regions.
- Cost sensitivity: tight. Goal: 40-60% reduction vs their current cloud-hosted endpoint spend.
- Models: prefer open weights (Llama3-family or Falcon derivatives) but will consider Redwood-verified variants; strong interest in 4-bit/8-bit quantization, int8 perf if accuracy ok.
- Workload characteristics: many short chats (avg 60 tokens), occasional long sessions up to 1024 tokens. High reuse of prefixes -> potential for KV/prefix caching.
- Routing: need policy to route high-risk traffic to private on-prem nodes, low-risk to dedicated pool. Automatic fallback required during capacity drain.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown and tracing hooks are must-haves for finance compliance.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS for keys, audit logs retention (7+ years for some flows), data residency: US-only for FRAudit dataset.
Notes from calls:
- "We can tolerate 2-3% generation quality degradation for 3-4x cost savings" — Head of ML (paraphrase).
- SE note: "Quantization accuracy unknown for their proprietary reranker; want controlled A/B tests."
